//: Ratchets for scripts/ci.mjs. Every entry is a thing CI would otherwise fail on, kept green by NAME and by reason. Adding one is a hand edit and shows in a diff; removing one is automatic (`bun run ci -- --update`) because the improvement direction never needs a decision. Same shape and same purpose as scripts/typecheck-baselines.json — see CLAUDE.md Invariant 14.
//exemptPackages: Directories under packages/ (plus the two example apps) with no `test` script. Without this list a package with no tests is indistinguishable from a passing one, which is the failure mode CI is aimed at. Key is the repo-relative directory.

exemptPackages.packages/datetime-kit: Claimed, not built — a README and no package.json. FJS-D14 asks what to do with it.
exemptPackages.packages/oracle: A mockup/ directory and nothing else; nothing in the repo references it. FJS-D14.
exemptPackages.packages/orion: Claimed, not built — basecamp's partner app. FJS-D14.
exemptPackages.example: A runnable app, not a package. Its six browser drives need `bun run api` + `bun run web` started by hand and sign in against a login rate limit (10 per 15 min), so they cannot run unattended. Covered by hand per CLAUDE.md § Running things.
exemptPackages.packages/sierra/example: Same — a runnable app whose drives need servers started by hand.

//generatedIgnored: Files that .gitignore excludes and that a source-extension sweep therefore flags. Each one must be GENERATED — a source file in this list is the `build/`-in-.gitignore incident happening again, where 20 files of Sierra's build pipeline were invisible to a fresh clone.

generatedIgnored.packages/basecamp/web/config/routes.js: Generated by Sierra's route scanner at dev/build time; packages/basecamp/.gitignore:14 excludes it deliberately.

//knownTestFailures: Packages whose own suite exits non-zero today. Listed so that a NEW failure is loud rather than lost in an already-red run. An entry whose suite now passes fails CI until it is removed — that is the ratchet, and `--update` removes it for you.

knownTestFailures.packages/jetty: FJS-030 — phase8 asserts the built islands/demo.js parses as a classic script and it does not: `Cannot use 'import.meta' outside a module`. MV3 content scripts are classic scripts. The other nine phases pass.
